resources.string: You can change this later in Settings.
Record meetings, lectures, interviews, and voice notes. Audio stays local by default, and recording needs no account or internet connection.

1. Tap the large Record button.
2. Pause or resume when needed.
3. Add markers at important moments.
4. Tap Stop & Save.
5. Find the recording in Library.

Choose transcript only, transcript with Smart Insights, or full analysis with speaker labels after saving. Transcripts may appear before later results. Longer recordings take longer, and AI models require separate storage. Recording still works without them.
Could not download the model. Check your connection or install it later in Settings.
About 65 MB for transcription, speech detection, and speaker labels. You can install it later.
Files stay on your device. The microphone is used only after you start recording. You may grant access now or later from the Recorder. No account is required for core recording.
Microphone access was not granted. You can enable it later when starting a recording or in system settings.
